$comment: MCP server catalog. Provisioned into VS Code's user mcp.json and ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json by `cortex setup`. GitHub authenticates with the stored PAT via an Authorization header (${env:GITHUB_TOKEN} from secure storage). Jira uses Atlassian's official remote Rovo server over OAuth (sign in once in-editor). Confluence is intentionally NOT an MCP server — it is served by the confluence REST skill using ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN + CONFLUENCE_URL. Server keys match the tool-ID prefixes in lib/core.mjs (CAPABILITY_MAP). _source is kept so Cortex updates/removes only its own entries; other _* fields are display metadata, stripped on write.

io.github.github/github-mcp-server._description: GitHub's official remote MCP server, authenticated with your stored PAT (no OAuth).

atlassian._description: Atlassian's official remote Rovo MCP server for Jira (OAuth — sign in once in-editor). Confluence is handled by the REST skill, not MCP.
